title: Our Story
text:
We’re Amanda and Lucy, and we believe you can have a bit of magic in everyday life.
We started playing mahjong together and loved everything about it–the strategy, the socializing, and those perfect moments when everything clicks. But we also shared something else: a love for immersive experiences where every single detail has been thoughtfully crafted to transport you somewhere extraordinary.
That’s when we realized we wanted to create mahjong sets the same way the most magical places on earth create their experiences. We pay extra attention to every detail: the width of the tiles and how they feel in your hands, the color choices that make your heart skip, the little easter eggs and surprises tucked into every set. We want to give you that same feeling you get when you step into a world where wonder is around every corner, except this magic happens right in your living room.
Our mission is simple:
 To craft luxury mahjong sets and accessories with artistry and care
 To honor the tradition and community that make mahjong so meaningful
 To inspire moments of laughter, beauty, and magic
For us, it isn’t just about mahjong. It’s about celebrating life’s moments, both big and small, and when you add a little magic, those moments become unforgettable.
Amanda & Lucy
